method: Read-only installed application asset inspection and allowlisted native UI Automation labels; no prompts, navigation, settings, restart or model requests.

nativeRead.interpretation: The current view did not expose a live Thinking/Working or completed-turn disclosure. Activity may be navigation; no transcript identity is inferred from that label.

verifiedPackedSources.finding: Worked for {time} is the completed-turn divider between agent activity and the final assistant response.
Working is the in-progress latest-turn heading.

Normal Thinking, waiting-for-answer and Pal Typing have separate presentation branches. Small fixed content uses opacity plus y=4 entry/exit for 150ms easeOut and a 200ms easeOut layout transition. The thinking-status opacity transition imports shared hT.
Export hT is bound to Iui: duration 300ms and cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1).
Tool summaries use real action labels such as Reading, Searching, Running, Ran and Stopped command, with available target details.
Pal header activity states distinguish Thinking, Working, Needs input, Ready and Paused. Working explicitly refers to computer use in this source.

secondaryLocalReference.finding: Collapsible animates real grid height and opacity while closed descendants are inert. Conversation following preserves explicit reader intent. AgentThinking is a configurable presentation component, not evidence that Namzu lacks real runtime phases.
secondaryLocalReference.limits: Concurrent local working copy; no clean upstream revision or license claim, no source copied. These are source observations, not newly measured reference DOM.

priorEvidence.finding: Earlier native inspection observed the completed Worked for disclosure and ordered public thoughts/commentary/tools. Namzu already verified actual-event Working/Thinking, 200ms collapsible motion and reduced motion.

adaptation.normalTranscript: Replace the generic live Activity heading with truthful admitted phases; preserve completed Worked for duration and action-specific tool rows. Stop/pause durations use a separator, and incomplete work does not claim successful completion.
adaptation.motion: 150ms fresh live entry, 300ms phase crossfade, existing 200ms collapse, reduced-motion cancellation and interrupted-frame continuity. Stored history, hydration, tab mounts and successive streaming chunks do not replay entry effects.
adaptation.pal: Keep delivered chat bubbles and concise Typing/Working; do not import coding-work disclosures into friend-style Pal chat.
adaptation.branding: Namzu branding and existing accessible primitives remain local.
